# Ascendancies

_Generated from PoB tree data `3.29`. Regenerate after any data update._

## Points

Primary and secondary ascendancies share **one pool of 8 points**. A point spent on
a Bloodline is a point not spent on the class, which is why both are in this file.

`CountAllocNodes` (`PassiveSpec.lua:822`) returns `used, ascUsed, secondaryAscUsed`.
`ascUsed` counts **every** node with an `ascendancyName`, Bloodline nodes included;
`secondaryAscUsed` re-counts the Bloodline subset. `Build.lua:908` warns when
`ascUsed > 8`, and separately when `secondaryAscUsed > 8`, so the total binds.
Trust the warning and check `ascUsed` on every build.

Nodes marked _(no point cost)_ are `isMultipleChoiceOption`, which `CountAllocNodes`
skips - they are a choice attached to another node rather than a purchase.

## Primary

Select with `build.spec:SelectClass(classId)` then
`build.spec:SelectAscendClass(ascendId)`. Attribute affinity is the class's own
starting attributes - it is a property of the class, not of the ascendancy.

## Secondary (Bloodlines)

Select with `build.spec:SelectSecondaryAscendClass(ascId)`. The call takes only an
ascId and does no class check, so any class may take any Bloodline. Bloodlines have
no attribute affinity - their start node sits in a detached group of its own.

| ascId | id | name |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | Abyssal | Abyssal Bloodline |
| 8 | Aul | Aul Bloodline |
